reply.emotion: excited and curious, dreaming of new places and adventures
notes: Viaggiare is an intransitive verb, so it takes the auxiliary verb essere in compound tenses: sono viaggiato is incorrect; you must say sono viaggiato only if you mean something else, but standard travel uses essere (e.g., sono viaggiato is wrong, you say ho viaggiato as an action or sono andato, but actually viaggiare takes avere when focusing on the action: ho viaggiato molto).

senses.definition: To go from one place to another, often over a long distance.

examples.text: Mi piace viaggiare in treno per vedere il paesaggio.
examples.translation: I like to travel by train to see the landscape.
examples.emotion: relaxed and appreciative, enjoying the slow pace of the journey

senses.definition: To move or be transmitted from one place to another, like light or sound.

examples.text: La luce viaggia più veloce del suono.
examples.emotion: fascinated and matter-of-fact, sharing an interesting scientific truth
